$comment: Pinned sources for the third-party executables Upscaly runs but does not compile. Every archive_sha256 and entry sha256 was verified against the actual downloaded bytes -- see scripts/fetch-sidecars.mjs, which is the only consumer that should read this file. Re-pinning realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan means bumping archive_url to a newer Real-ESRGAN-ncnn-vulkan release tag; re-pinning ffmpeg means picking a newer BtbN autobuild-YYYY-MM-DD-HH-MM release tag (never the floating 'latest' alias, which repoints to a new build on every BtbN run and cannot be hash-pinned).

ffmpeg.$comment: GPL build (BtbN win64-gpl-8.1, ffmpeg n8.1.2) rather than LGPL: Upscaly falls back to the bundled libx264 software encoder when no hardware encoder (nvenc/qsv/amf/mediafoundation) is available, so every video job can still complete. Upscaly fetches this at install time rather than bundling it, so the app never redistributes GPL-licensed binaries itself -- see docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
